newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Small companies drag down Mauritius index.
newsitem.headline: Small companies drag down Mauritius index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, semdex, eased by 0.21 points to 369.21 on Friday under the weight of falling share prices of small capitalised listed companies, share dealers said.
Transactions totalled 21.19 million rupees on 576,296 shares from 11.07 million rupees on 404,132 shares on Wednesday.

Dealers said the lower semdex was the net result of share price rises of a couple leading stocks being offset by price falls of the smaller companies. Owing to the higher volume, dealers said foreigners were active on the market.
"The market is presently in a situation where foreign investors are interested in the leading shares while the smaller companies are being left on their own," one dealer said.
He identified the leading shares as being those in the banking and hotel sectors.

Mauritius Commercial Bank rose 50 cents to 86 rupees on 170,150 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 11.10 rupees on 280,700 shares. Sun Resorts remained at 41.50 rupees on 22,628 shares and New Mauritius Hotels climbed 40 cents to 33.90 rupees on 3,000 shares.

Stocks on the downside were mainly those in the investment sector. Mauritius Development Investment Trust lost 30 cents to 8.70 rupees on 1,200 shares, National Investment Trust was 10 cents lower to 13 rupees on 11,150 shares and Promotion And Development shed 50 cents to 16.40 rupees on 10,150 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert slipped by 80 cents to 40.50 rupees on 4,200 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius was down 20 cents to 41.50 rupees on 22,628 shares.
Rogers gained 50 cents to 99 rupees on 5,769 shares and Ireland Blyth rose 10 cents to 14.70 rupees on 14,195 shares.
